message.subject: Re: Question
message.body: Continue correcting the draft; do not hand off a blocked draft yet. Verified public evidence is now in /home/alex/Work/GenUIExperiment/plans/evidence/worker-accounting.json, released-worker.json, active-worker.json and current-run-snapshot.json (sanitized). worker-list [--run] returns result.workers rows with runId, dispatchId, taskId, agentTerminalHandle, dispatchStatus, workerState, terminalState and resource. Before start/attach use exact ORCA_TERMINAL_HANDLE, terminal show --terminal that handle, and worker-list to reject any active dispatched attempt for that handle (across Runs); no guessed env role flags. run-show result.run.coordinator_handle proves bound Run owner; worktree show --worktree path:<cwd> provides exact repo ID. Revalidate Pi sessionId/cwd/terminal handle/Run owner on resume and before effects. worker-show has result.terminalResource: releaseState released + ownershipState released + matching ownerDispatchId is released proof. Unknown/missing fields fail closed. For reuse, ownerDispatchId must change to a verified live new Dispatch on the same terminal; retain must have runtime-confirmed user/explicit retention reason, not a model declaration. A cleanup command can remain CLI-operated; ack must inspect evidence. For reply recovery there is NO proven coordinator question-status API. Persist the actual successful reply receipt (result.question.status answered plus matching message_id/run_id and answer_message_id/body); restore it after reload. If the mutation result was lost/malformed or receipt was not persisted, explicitly pause, retain the Delivery, and report exact recovery needed; do not auto-repeat the answer or call worker ask --resume as coordinator. That conservative documented unresolved state is permitted v1 and must be tested. Also fix the other early-review findings, including serialized authoritative capacity and bounded output. Please process all queued guidance before final tests. Pin 0.86.1 unless an actual resolution error is reported.
